results.original: A small transformer uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training. Regularization helps it generalize beyond its training examples. After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.
results.reconstruction: The small transformer uses self attention to process text and uses backpropagation to improve its predictions of the small transformer. During training, backpropagation enhances the quality of these predictions. Regularization helps the small transformer achieve generalization beyond training examples. After training, quantization inhibits the memory requirements of the small transformer. Retrieval augmented generation enables the use of external documents when answering questions.
results.reason: The passage was constructed by sequentially linking concepts via their defined relations in source occurrence order. 'small transformer' initiates the chain using 'self attention' and 'backpropagation'. The specific qualifier 'to process text' attached to self attention and 'to improve its predictions' (and the related 'predictions of the small transformer') were integrated into the verb phrases. The temporal condition 'during training' for backpropagation's enhancement effect was preserved as a clause. 'Regularization' helping 'generalization beyond training examples' with the qualifier 'of the small transformer' was added next. The 'quantization' relation, specifically noting the 'after training' condition and its inhibitory effect on 'memory requirements', followed. Finally, 'retrieval augmented generation' enabling 'use of external documents' with the qualifier 'when answering questions' concluded the text. All negations (inhibits), modality (enables without claiming production), and participant roles were strictly adhered to without inferring additional facts.
